project.visitorDecision: Identify the exact source-backed snowfall observation behind a reported top ranking, find it geographically and inspect its NWS text.
project.primaryAction: Select one ranked NWS observation and read its original NWS report, or locate the approximate reported coordinates on a map without treating them as public access.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: The National Weather Service publishes source observations; availability and completeness vary by reporting place and event. This page does not treat a lack of report as a lack of snow.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: The Iowa Environmental Mesonet archive carries NWS local storm reports, but the report's magnitude can cover differing accumulation durations. A 72-hour search window is not a 72-hour snow accumulation measurement.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: Reported latitude and longitude indicate observation vicinity only and do not independently verify an address, safe route, parking or public access.

decisionState.selectedIdField: state.selectedReportKey built from source report place, county and reportedAt
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: Existing SnowCore window/region NWS rows and the site's original allowlisted productUrl; the selected key is derived from the same row as the Leaflet marker and ranked button.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: When a selected report falls outside a changed window/region, clear the selection; missing original text is explicitly labeled, missing map tiles reveal the source table, stale feeds suppress current claims.

scenarios.input: Open a 7-day report week with multiple NWS observations.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The leading reported amount and timestamp appear above the map; no individual ranked report is selected until clicked.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: All amounts are explicitly observed NWS reports of varying durations; the map is not an access map.

scenarios.input: Select the second ranked NWS place with a native button or click a mapped circle marker.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Report detail switches to the exact place, amount, observation age and allowlisted original NWS source, with a coordinate-only maps search when valid.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Reported coordinates are approximate and are not travel directions, parking or public entrances.

scenarios.input: Select rank A, then B, then A, and switch the time window.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The original source, identity, pressed state and location are restored for A; a different period clears the prior selection.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: A place outside the new window is never presented as still selected or as current.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Original NWS archive link, season reference tables and guide answers remain readable; no interactive map or fabricated current observations.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No current snow estimate is invented without the NWS feed.

scenarios.input: Block OSM map tiles and Leaflet script.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: A short map-unavailable message and opened source-linked report list replace the blank map region.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Failed map initialization does not imply anything about outdoor conditions or official report existence.

scenarios.input: Inject a cached NWS response aged three hours and ACIS season response aged forty hours.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Current snowfall figures, rank selection and season comparison are suppressed, with original archive and historical context available.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Source ages are checked before presenting any current figure; no stale observation is described as new.

scenarios.input: Select a report without allowlisted productUrl or valid Michigan coordinates.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Explicitly state original text unavailable and omit unsupported coordinate-map action while retaining report amount and time.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No guessed source URL or location is constructed.

failures.no-js: Original NWS Local Storm Report archive and current guide text remain in server-rendered HTML without any script.
failures.no-tiles: Collapse the map to a source-linked status and open the accessible full NWS report table.
failures.no-image: No photograph or new generated image is required for a report, so no missing photograph can hide the observation answer.
failures.stale-data: Stop showing current NWS ranking and season bar states after conservative source-age cutoffs, retaining historical references.
